J01.contracts.source_closure_rule: Record all transitively imported implementation source paths and content SHA256, plus lockfile/compiler/runtime/config digests. Every frozen contract artifact must exist on the candidate. Tracked extension paths are future producer outputs, not initial gate prerequisites; adding or modifying them invalidates all dependent evidence and requires re-freezing the composed contract and dependency manifest. Any candidate or digest change invalidates all dependent evidence; no cross-candidate reuse.
